title: The reflection in Gully's window
logline: Gully's shack window from the dock, and in it a man in plaid from the front — reflected, so the page has him facing us and can't show his face for the glare. The corkboard behind the glass, through him.

panels.composition: A shingle shack's window from the dock reflecting a man in blue plaid facing the glass, his face lost in the glare, the corkboard inside visible through his reflection.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a shingle shack's window seen from a dock reflecting a man in blue plaid flannel facing the glass with his face lost in glare, a crowded corkboard inside visible through the reflection, no words legible
